attributes.board_name: North Dakota Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of veterinary or vet-tech associations, board-approved seminars, AAVSB RACE programs, college wet labs, objective commercial presentations (approval); exchange program and board meeting attendance limited
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed fewer than 24 months before the even-year renewal: requirement adjusted proportionally.
rules.audit_note: Proof of attendance on request; verification may be through a third-party database.
rules.notes: License renewed annually by Dec 31 ($30); CE (12 h in prior 24 months, at least 9 in person/live virtual) certified at even-year renewals. Board: 2026 renewal still uses previous rules, 8 hours.
